subject: EU-exclusive processing & VPC — evidence and next steps
messages:
From: Sven Müller <sven.muller@medident.eu>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:14:00 +0200
Subject: EU-only processing commitment + VPC and evidence request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking the time in the demo last week. We have two gating items before we can move to procurement sign-off: an explicit contractual commitment that MediDent data is processed only in EU-hosted infrastructure, and a private connectivity option (VPC/Private Connector) so no production traffic traverses public internet egress.

Can you provide: 
- A short attestation that Redwood will process MediDent data exclusively in EU regions for the contracted models and that backups/metrics will not leave the EU.
- A list of evidence items we can upload to our security team: latest SOC 2 report, completed SIG/CAIQ or CAIQ responses, network diagrams for the private connector, and any DPIA notes you have for EU processing.
- An ops playbook for how a customer can validate region isolation (staging checklist / test plan) and a proposed timeline to run those checks.

We also have a short security questionnaire (attached) that our InfoSec team will use — would appreciate confirmation you can return that within two weeks. We will need to align legal on SCCs/DPA language; please loop in your counsel early.

Regards,
Sven Müller
Head of IT Security
MediDent GmbH

Attachments: Medident-Security-Questionnaire-2027.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sven Müller <sven.muller@medident.eu>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: EU-only processing commitment + VPC and evidence request

Hi Sven — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the questionnaire.

Short answers up front: yes, we can commit to EU-only processing for the contracted model endpoints and provide a private connector option. We can also deliver SOC 2 and completed SIG/CAIQ artifacts and a technical playbook for validation.

I've looped in Priya (legal) and Dev (solutions) to scope technical evidence and DPA/SCC language. Proposed next steps:
- Redwood to return completed questionnaire + SOC 2 and CAIQ within 10 business days.
- Dev to share a staging test plan and network diagram for the private connector by EOD Thursday.
- Priya to draft a short EU-only addendum to our DPA for mutual review.

Could you confirm whether you need a signed addendum before we provide the attestation, and whether MediDent can provide a temporary staging account or VPN endpoint for validation?

I am attaching our high-level EU processing attestation for initial review. We'll follow up with more granular artifacts.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Enterprise — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0199

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Sven Müller <sven.muller@medident.eu>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:30:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing commitment + VPC and evidence request

Thanks — adding the technical details we will deliver. Note: internal notes are below, but I'm CCing Sven so MediDent can see the proposed artifacts.

Deliverables (technical):
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary) and SOC 2 ISMS summary (we can provide SOC2-report-2026.pdf).
- Completed SIG/CAIQ responses in the spreadsheet format you provided.
- Network diagram and architecture for the Private Connector (shows VPC peering, NAT configuration, ingress/egress controls).
- Data flow mapping for the contracted models (what's stored, retained, and where KV cache/prefix cache live).
- Staging validation playbook: a checklist of tokenized payload tests, headers & TLS inspection, IP address ranges to verify, and a short script for verifying exported logs do not contain EU -> non-EU hops.
- Test plan timeline: 1) Day 0 — exchange IP/VPN creds; 2) Day 1–2 — deploy test model to customer staging project; 3) Day 3 — run validation scripts; 4) Day 4 — review findings and sign-off.

Operational constraints / notes:
- Our private connector routes for EU-exclusive customers are pinned to EU regions and are served from our EU-dedicated serving pools. We will provide a signed routing attestation and the exact region names used.
- Backups and analytics metrics collection are configurable per-tenant; default is EU retention but some telemetry aggregated at org-level for platform health may be stored in our EU control plane — we will provide explicit fields in the attestation.
- For the DPIA notes: we will provide a short risk summary and mitigations specific to model inference and caching.

Questions for MediDent:
- Do you have a preferred staging network (VPN endpoint or SFTP server) for us to push logs?
- Any mandatory scan or 3rd-party assessor you expect during the validation?

I'll prepare the network diagram and the staging playbook and upload to the shared drive by Thursday EOD.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 13:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing commitment + VPC and evidence request

Hi team — quick legal take and proposed language.

We can and should provide an EU-only processing addendum. Key points to include in the DPA addendum:
- Commit to processing and storing personal data only within EU/EEA regions for the contracted services and explicit model IDs referenced in the SOW.
- State where logs and backups are stored and the retention durations.
- Include SCCs (European Commission standard contractual clauses) reference + redline to confirm no additional cross-border transfers outside what the EU SCCs allow.
- Add audit and inspection rights: MediDent can request evidence and one technical validation within a 6-month window post-activation (scope limited to the staging verification plan).

I'm attaching a draft addendum (DPA-eu-only-addendum-v1.docx) for internal review. I recommend we get procurement engaged if they insist on a signature prior to producing the full CAIQ/SIG (we can provide redacted artifacts before signature).

Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Sven
